## Download

Grab the `.dmg` for your Mac below: `arm64` for Apple silicon, `x64` for Intel.

## What's changed

- Command palette: search every setting by name (#140) @maya-chen

## New features

- Updates: What's new shows the release notes before you restart (#142) @maya-chen
- Updates: Restart when idle waits for running chats, and cut-off chats pick up after a restart (#142) @maya-chen
- Terminal: open a second terminal tab per workspace (#138) @sam-lee

## Fixes

- Fix the diff view jumping to the top after a push (#141) @sam-lee

## Docs

- Docs: explain worktree cleanup (#139) @sam-lee

## Maintenance

- deps: bump @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk from 0.3.330 to 0.3.334 (#143) @[dependabot[bot]](https://github.com/apps/dependabot)
- ci: cache Electron downloads (#137) @sam-lee

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Benbentwo/choo-choo/compare/v0.4.1...v0.5.0
